# Isaiah Chapter 62 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 12 verses]*

*Not silent for Zion; new name; no more Forsaken; watchmen on walls; prepare the way*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** You shall be called by a new name that the mouth of the LORD will give. This chapter not silent for zion.

*-- LOGOS*
